constraints.session_size: Measure sessions by CONTENT, not minutes. A full session = warm-up + new words taught inside sentences + enough production that each new word is USED at least once + re-drilling the sticky ones.
constraints.new_words_per_session: target ~8 (range 6-10, hard cap ~12); each used >=2x in production. Aim for an EVEN ~40-50/week — see CLAUDE.md and progress.json vocabulary tracker.
constraints.frequency: TODO — how often you plan to study (daily recommended).
constraints.deadline: TODO — any fixed deadline, or 'none fixed; steady progress'.

preferences.tone: Minimal and direct. NO praise, cheerleading, or filler — it's just more to read. State whether an answer is right or wrong, fix what's wrong, move on. (Adjust to taste.)
preferences.correction_style: Show the correction INLINE using ~~wrongword~~ **rightword** (strike the wrong token, bold the fix right after it) so you see exactly what changed in place. Add a one-line reason. Mark fully-correct sentences with a leading check. When asked to translate FROM your native language, the tutor does NOT pre-supply the target word/form — that defeats the exercise; you ask if stuck.
preferences.prompt_batch_size: In production, give a SMALL BATCH of ~3 sentences/prompts at a time. You answer the batch, the tutor corrects, then the next batch.
preferences.always_speak: Sessions are text-based: you TYPE your answers as the in-session production. Each session ends with a small take-away aloud mission. A weekly voice conversation is the real spoken rep.
preferences.comprehensive_sentences: Default to LONGER, multi-clause production sentences that COMBINE many systems at once, NOT short single-rule sentences — this is the main retention lever. Short drills are for a quick warm-up only.
preferences.new_situations: Rotate contexts (work, weather, shopping, friends, city, ...) so examples stay fresh rather than anchoring everything on one topic.
